windPrecisionPolicy: baseOffset is normalized texture input, not metres. History compares current XZ input with every candidate frame using0.13*billowPeriod metres per input unit. Maximum equivalent noise-coordinate displacement is0.5m; changing wind caps age at2. No rigid cloud translation is applied. This input bound is validated against actual full-render RGB and transmission errors.
depthPrecisionPolicy: Lighting alpha is ARGBHalf. Exact cases allow at most one adjacent finite nonnegative half encoding per pixel, not a fixed metre tolerance. RGB, transmission and first-hit checks retain their original limits. Per-pixel half bits are reported for the worst difference and first 32 exact-case differences; all pixels contribute to violation counts.
